items.title: What kind of shithole country livestreams executions? Our kind.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
For We the People, life continues to out of control.

Basic goods and services remain unaffordable. Inflation and unemployment are on the rise. Our food is unsafe to eat. Our government lies to us. Our once-staunch allies hate our guts, and openly mock us. Masked, trigger-happy federal thugs roam the streets of our cities. Our hallowed national monuments have been shuttered, or bulldozed to rubble.

Our detached, demented president has completely checked out of fixing any of this shit, preferring to focus on useless vanity projects in honor of his own crappy self.

But We the People getting one very special thing, and it’s just for us. Know what that one thing is? Get ready for it: Public executions.

Hegseth on Nidal Hasan: “He’s gonna get a firing squad of soldiers. As it should be. We’ll make sure that people are able to watch it. That it’s public. Because people need to understand that there’s serious consequences for these types of things.”

Seriously, what the damn?

Did you notice how completely fucking excited Piss-Drunk Pete was, in that clip? He was absolutely as he burbled away at a mile a minute about how the military was going to publicly kill the shit out of someone. That’s insane. happy about meting out death — and nobody who’s that over-the-moon about killing should be put in charge of the lives of others.

We’re going backwards as a country. The last public execution in the US was the hanging of some dude named Reiney Betha, on August 14, 1936. After that, states came to their senses, realized that kind of spectacle was barbaric, and stared passing laws against it.

And now, Piss-Drunk Pete wants to bring it back, because he thinks that shit’s awesome. As always with these fuckfaces,

Hey, you know what other country also does public executions? Iran. Isn’t Preznit Fuckwit always telling us how we’re more civilized than they are? That’s such a cute story, Donny, tell it again.

Oh, but at the same time we’re going backwards, we’re also going forwards. We’re bringing public executions into the twenty-first century. Check out this abomination.

The public will be able to watch the execution of a former US Army major by firing squad, US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has said.

A Defense Department official told the BBC the execution of Nidal Hasan, who shot dead 13 unarmed US soldiers at Fort Hood in 2009, would be livestreamed.

It is believed it would be the first public execution in the US in almost a century. The decision to livestream it is “unprecedented in the modern era” and “on uncertain legal terrain,” said John Mills, a lawyer who works with inmates sentenced to death.

Oh, come on. Are you fucking me?!

Who’s going to watch a livestream of someone getting firing-squadded to smithereens? Cultists?

More importantly, who’s going to provide the livestream stream? Netflix? Amazon? Facebook? What corporation wants to be complicit in this barbarity? You’d hope the answer would be , but I can think of a few tech bros who would be that horny to curry favor with Dear Leader, and volunteer to host that shit for free.

Is this who we want to be, as a nation? Do we really want to be known as the country that broadcasts state-sponsored death? Count me out. I want no part of this fuckery.

It’s so much fun being a rogue nation, isn’t it?

Ten days ago, the state of Tennessee tried to execute Christa Pike by lethal injection. If you’ve been following that story, you know that they fucked it up royally. Instead of dying, Pike spent hours moaning and crying in pain, and ended up in the hospital in a coma, with severe burns to her arms and shoulders.

Imagine if that shit-show had been livestreamed.

Maybe it should have been. Maybe the public outrage over that obscene level of cruelty would have started a national conversation about the death penalty.

Now here’s something Dear Leader shat out onto his crappy app yesterday. It’s one of those posts that, when it shows up in your social feed, you go, ‘oh come on, that’s fake as fuck, not even Donny is crazypants’ — .

The White House considers anyone that uses the term, “Artificial Intelligence,” as opposed to the highly accepted new and more accurate term, “Super Intelligence,” THE ENEMY! President DONALD J. TRUMP

Who even talks like this? Just because we don’t agree on what to call the janky, six-fingered plagiarism robots, we’re now the all-caps ENEMY? How can any one person be that infantile?

I’m so tired of him. I’m so tired of the relentless dumbfuckery. I’m so tired of the bone-crushing stupidity, and the childish if-you-don’t-agree-with-me-you’re-a-poopy-head mentality.

And I’m fucking exhausted that there’s now an entire infrastructure devoted to making this utter failure feel good about his own shitty self.

Did you know that Donny was awarded another Emotional Support Trophy yesterday?

But Donny’s minders also did this: they took a genuine award that Donny’s uncle — the actual MIT professor, John G. Trump — had won in 1983, stuck it behind some chintzy gold frame, and with great fanfare, presented it to Donny, so that he could stand there, beaming, and pretend that he had somehow earned it all by his own Big Boy self.

Look at this preening asshole. He’s just so eternally embarrassing. Put that shit down, numb-nuts, you haven’t won anything.

And now, speaking of actual awards that Donny will win—

“Thank you very much. If you clap a little bit more, I may share this prize with Trump.”

Really weird how there’s currently no Truth Social post from Donny, congratulating Navi Pillay for winning. What’s up with that?

Well, it’s Friday, and — — we made it through another week in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

Here are a couple more pics of Katie and her mom. These photos are undated but they’re obviously from the early 1990s.

Have a great Friday, everyone.

items.title: We’ve endured ten long years of this shit. Lucky us.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
In her most recent post, the indispensable Heather Cox Richardson reminds us of a fact that somehow had completely flown under my radar. Yesterday marked ten years since the release of the Access Hollywood tape, confirming in our minds the thing we all already suspected: that the racist game show host running for president was also a misogynistic piece of shit.

That tape — in which the racist game show host literally bragged about grabbing women ‘by the pussy,’ — should have consigned him to the rotting dustbin of history, but for some maddening reason, it didn’t. As a result, every day for the last ten years, the racist game show host has been — — inflicting himself on us.

You’re welcome, America. Lucky us.

“I could have done very bad things to Hillary Clinton. I could have done very, very bad things to Joe Biden. I could have done very bad things to Barack Hussein Obama.… I can do whatever I want, if I want.”

Well, , then. That’s certainly good to know. Thanks for sharing, Donny.

Tell me, what are we supposed to with this information? File it away for future reference? Fear this idiot ? He’s already the world’s most tiresome asshole.

Who talks like this? It’s so unpresidential. Our Predator-in-Chief is unfit for office, and growing worse by the day.

‘I can do whatever I want, if I want.’

Why does everything that seeps out of Preznit Fuckwit’s rancid anus-mouth sound like something that he or his dead pedo bestie Jeffrey Epstein would have said to one of the Motel-a-Lago ‘spa girls’?

What was the context for this boast of how awful Donny could be, ? From what point A did we get to this point B?

Yesterday’s Oval Bordello dog-and-pony show was ostensibly held so that Dear Leader could brag about how he had automatically enrolled every child in America — — into his dodgy new ‘Trump Accounts’ scam. How did we get from to ‘I could fuck everyone’s shit but good, if I wanted to’?

For heaven’s sake, there were in the room.

Trump to children in the Oval Office: “You stay there. You’re so good looking. The press can admire you.”

Eww. Shut the fuck up, Piggy.

“There’s never been anybody in the history of the Nobel Prize that deserves it more. I settled eight wars. I stopped the total obliteration of the world.”

Oh. My. God. An entire year has passed, and this colicky little piss-baby is still whining about not getting the Nobel Peace Prize. Donny has such a ginormous back-catalog of grievances that I’d completely forgotten about the Nobel.

Could Grudgie the Whale please stop bellyaching for five consecutive seconds? Would that be too much to ask?

Which brings us to Dear Leader’s other public event from yesterday, a campaign rally in San Antonio, Texas — because you’ll never guess what the stupid shit did. He doubled down on the dumbfuck.

“Let them hit a missile into San Diego or Los Angeles on the way. You want to see a horror show? Let them hit San Diego. Let them hit Los Angeles. You want to see some bad things happen?”

No, we don’t. No one wants to see bad things happen. What the fuck is wrong with you?

“I can do whatever I want, if I want.”

Yeah, we know. You keep saying that.

Just you watch. Nuking California is now going to become a centerpiece of every one of Donny’s speeches. It’s going to turn into a laugh line, because MAGA

Donny has the emotional maturity of a toddler. His goal is to be the center of attention, and it doesn’t matter how he gets it. Whatever works. He knows that the grown-ups are annoyed by his antics, so he’s going to keep on doing it — because any kind of attention is good.

But let’s circle back to yesterday’s Oval Bordello dog-and-pony show, because I know there’s one question you’ve been dying to ask.

‘Hey, Uncle Jeff, as soon as someone else started talking, did the narcoleptic old fart factory fall fast asleep and crop-dust his Emotional Support Flunkies — without their consent — with the pungent aroma of ass music?’

Remember, Donny can ‘do whatever he wants, if he wants’ — and that includes sleeping his way though his entire failed presidency.

Now, let me turn it around. I have a question for , dear readers.

Forgive me, but Ms. Dell seems higher than a kite. Is there something in the water at the White House? I feel it’s a legit question to ask, because I’m pretty sure that Susan Dell has joined Space Nazi aboard Forkship One, and is somewhere out in deep space right now.

What do you say we consent to some Daily Claudia?

I remain fascinated that so many of the selfies on Ms Spouse’s phone that I had assumed were static images, are actually what Samsung calls ‘motion photos.’

Here are two vids that I’d previously posted as still photos, of Ms Spouse and Bestie Kathy, at Half Moon, on May 29, 2025.

Have a great Thursday, everyone. Thank you to all of you who emailed or commented in support of the Daily Claudia. Don’t worry, it’s not going away at any time in the near future. I mean, eventually I will run out of photos — but we’'ll cross that bridge when we come to it.

items.title: Breaking: World’s biggest asshole has world’s most ginormous ass
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
And we’re going to get to that bizarre chunk of what-the-fuck-is-even-going-on-back-there, I promise. But first—

Folks, one of the more stunning things about our profoundly damaged, broken-inside Sociopath-in-Chief is that he just can’t ever have a normal human response to You’d love nothing more than to add ‘no matter how hard he tries’ to that observation, but let’s face it. Preznit Fuckwit doesn’t try at all — .

Reporter: “Your meeting with the Gold Star families today, how did it go?”

Donny: “It was great … these are the most incredible people, so I invited them to check out the— check out the new helipad, check out the new ballroom, and check out the new helicopter.”

Yesterday, Donny’s babysitters had arranged for him to meet with the Gold Star families — the families of service members who died while serving their country. It would have been the perfect opportunity to for Donny to show off his human side, and erase the stain of having just invited Iran to nuke Los Angeles and San Diego. All he had to do was mumble a few words about

It was a softball, gently lobbed right down the middle of the plate, and Dear Leader should have smacked it a country mile.

But Donny doesn’t have a human side, so he fucking whiffed it. He made it all about himself. ‘Oh, did your kid die or something? Come see my new toys. Helicopter! Ballroom!’

Seriously, Donny — the media won’t say it, but I will. What the actual fuck is wrong with you?

This is not normal behavior. This is some sick psychopathic shit. It staggers the mind that the chief executive of our country not only can’t be bothered to pretend to care — he genuinely has no clue why he care.

Seriously, if Donny can’t eat it, or fuck it, or make money off of it, he has no use for it — and there’s nothing in the world that’s going to make him care about it.

This is a photo from Donny’s other public appearance yesterday, a speech at the Sparrows Point Shipyard. In it, we see him shaking hands with Baltimore Ravens punter Ryan Eckley, as Ravens players Tyler Loop, Nicholas Moore, and Marlon Humphrey look on.

I’m sorry, but I continue to be fascinated by whatever Dear Leader’s got going on in his

Check out Marlon Humphrey. He can’t believe what he’s seeing, either.

Here’s another shot of that ungodly , taken two weeks ago during Donny’s playdate with China’s Xi.

What in the actual fuck? Donny’s bizarre bulge isn’t even ass-shaped. What’s going on back there?

It is a toaster oven? Has the Diaper Nurse rigged up some methane-fueled oven back there so that she and Dear Leader can partake in midnight toaster strudels without having to wake the White House staffers? Or is Natty making Donny wear the diapers at once, so she can have a little peace and quiet?

Can Jack Smith please look into this, after the next Democratic president appoints him Attorney General?

Meanwhile, Republicans keep inadvertently producing Democratic campaign ads. Here’s the latest contribution, from the limpest dick ever to wield the House Speaker’s gavel, Holy Mike Johnson.

Scott Jennings: “Let’s say Democrats take the House. How sure are you that they would immediately move to impeach President Trump?”

Holy Mike: “It’s guaranteed. Probably on the first day.”

Don’t threaten me with a good time, Mike.

That should be the Democrats’ closing argument: ‘We’re going to impeach the shit out of this guy. And we’re not stopping with him. Piss-Drunk Pete is next. Then, Bobby Brainworms, and all the way down the line.”

Look, I know there’s a case to be made that ‘impeachment is a waste of time’ — that, unless the Dems pick up 21 seats in the Senate (which they won’t), any impeachment House would be a symbolic act at best.

But I’m not going to make that case. The case I’m going to make ‘is so fucking what if it is?’

Donny has been committing high crimes and misdemeanors every single day since he slithered back in power. Are we just going to ignore that shit? I hope not. A symbolic impeachment is better than no impeachment at all.

Now it’s time to sit back and enjoy Susan Collins getting her do-nothing ass handed to her by her Democratic opponent, Troy Jackson, at a televised debate last night.

Susan Collins: “I was successful at getting concrete, pulp, and road salt removed from the tariff list.”

Troy Jackson: “What about everything else? We can’t eat road salt. And the thing about it is, that with everything she’s doing with the Iran war, there will be so many less people that can afford to drive that I’m not even sure the road salt is gonna be worth anything, either.”

Susan Collins has been a senator since 1997. For almost thirty years, she’s been so fucking that this is the record she has to run on: she Made Road Salt Great Again.

You had a nice run, Suze. Thirty years is a long time to keep cashing those paychecks while doing nothing to earn them. It’s time to retire. Take Glitch McConnell with you, while you’re at it.

This is the work of Danish sculptor Jens Galschiøt, and —

Inscribed on the base is a satirical pledge attributed to “The King of Injustice.” It reads: “I am sitting on the back of a man. He is sinking under my burden. I will do anything to help him. Except stepping down from his back.”

Gee, I wonder who they could be talking about?

Danish MEP Per Clausen commended the unveiling of the new statue, saying: “If someone is so thin-skinned that they cannot tolerate this sculpture being exhibited in the European Parliament, then they have no place on the world stage.”

Got that, Donny? If you don’t like it, STFU. You’ve brought this on yourself. Thanks to you, we’re now a rogue nation — to the point where even our European allies are happily mocking the shit out of you.

And now it’s Daily Claudia time.

Here are a couple more selfies I pulled off of Ms Spouse’s phone. Oh look, it’s Katie and her mom, in New London, Connecticut, on Katie’s 34th birthday, July 11, 2025. Oh my god, we have video.

Folks, just a final word before I go. If you are so offended by the Daily Claudia that you are moved to cancel your paid subscription, I have just one small request to make of you: keep it to yourself. I don’t need to know.

Have a great Wednesday, everyone.

items.title: No biggie, it’s just our shithole president, inviting Iran to ‘take out’ Los Angeles and San Diego
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
“And again, remember. With the war, it’s just artificial. It’s a little bit high. It’s a small price to pay. for keeping the world safe. For keeping our country safe. They could take out a city. Let ’em take— let it— let ’em take out Los Angeles. Let ’em take our San Diego. That’s— this is a very small price to pay.”

Wait a minute — did this depraved shithead just give Iran permission to nuke a couple of our cities? Did he actually call such an act ‘a very small price to pay’?

Is Preznit Fuckwit … ? Is he serious? Is he so demented that he has no idea what he’s actually saying? Does it even matter why Donny said what he said? Dude is clearly unfit for office, and growing worse by the day.

Where are you, worthless scribblers of the corporate-controlled press?

Imagine that Sleepy Joe Biden’s autopen had blundered its way into an unwinnable war, and then invited our adversary to nuke the shit out of us. The press would have had a field day, falling all the fuck over themselves in a mad dash to file their stories.

Jake Tapper would have orgasmed on the spot.

Where are the calls for Donny to resign?

Remember Joe Biden’s last year in office? The press had their knives out. Every time Joe stumbled over a word, or took too long to reply to a question, every newspaper in the land would shit out editorial after editorial, calling Biden icky and old and smelly, and demanding that he resign immediately,

Where are you now, O Glorious Editorial Writers? Donny is in fact icky and old — and he probably smells like shit. Have you seen one call for Dear Leader to step down, ? I haven’t. Why the fuck not?

Shouldn’t Donny calling for the deaths of millions of Americans be a more important story than Joe Biden taking three seconds to remember a diplomat’s name? In any sane world, it would be. Let’s fucking go, media. Do your goddamned jobs.

“You need to be a student at the top of your class at MIT to turn on a lawnmower nowadays, you know? But I got rid of all that stuff. Now you can have a LAWNMOWER. Boom!!”

What is this fucking idiot — this pampered fool — who has never done a day’s labor in his life, imagine he’s done to improve? What did he?What is he hallucinating about?

Last summer, I bought a new lawnmower. It was the same as every lawnmower I’ve had since the 1960s. You pull the string and it goes vroom-vroom. Hey Jake Tapper, maybe you can explain it to me. What exactly has Donny done to Make Lawnmowers Great Again?

Why is the crowd clapping like trained seals at Dear Leader’s fever-swamp bullshit? My god, they’re just as brain dead as he is.

Again, Donny has been getting away with this shit for literal years, nattering on and on about stoves that don’t light, or toilets you have to flush a million times. Where are the worthless scribblers?

“It’ll end very quickly and prices are gonna come down very sharply. You might say, ‘please, please, sir, it’s going down too fast!’ You watch. You watch what’s going to happen in a very short period of time.”

Ohhhhh, okay. This unwinnable don’t-you-dare-call-it-a-war on Iran — the one that was only supposed to last one day; the one that Donny has claimed we’ve already won twenty times or more — now, it’s going to end very quickly. Any day now, just you wait and see — and then prices will plummet, and big, strong cultists, the afternoon sun rippling off their massive biceps, blinded by the uncontrollable tears of joy coursing down their ruddy cheeks, grateful for cheap gas like few thought possible, and the easy-to-start lawnmowers like no one’s ever seen before, and the radioactive craters where Los Angeles and San Diego used to be — they will all come up to Dear Leader and go ‘sir! sir! we can’t stand it any more! it’s going down too fast! Sir!”

And then, pigs will start flying out of my ass.

Donny never stops promising us that there’s going to be so much wining, we’re going to get tired of all the winning. Fuck that noise. I’m still waiting for the winning to start.

Wouldn’t you love it if our press would spend even ten minutes honestly reporting on any of this shit?

Top California officials denounce President Trump after he Iran could “take out” Los Angeles or San Diego

Dear Leader to say what he said. How helpful of you to point that out, CNN. I can’t wait for CNN’s report that San Diego to be a smoking ruin.

﻿First Thing: ‘Deranged’ and ‘dangerous’ Trump calls for Iran to strike US cities amid historic ratings low

That’s more like it. Are you paying attention, US press?

It’s time for a palate cleanse. Let’s watch in awe as Davram Stiefler of the Good Liars tries and fails to get a gang of cultists to answer the age-old question,

Davram Stiefler: “Is everyone worried about socialism?”

MAGA: “Oh, 100%. It never works”

Stiefler: “For the viewers, what is socialism?”

MAGA: “Socialism is pretty much, I mean, it’s control of everything, I mean, they want control and there’s no… uhm… I don’t even… how to explain it, but… you have no control at all. I mean it’s just, it’s their way or the highway”

Stiefler: “But as an economic form of governance, what is it?”

I can’t even with these dumbfucks. The definition of socialism as an economic form of governance is . Thanks a lot, Brainiac. You’ve really done us a solid with that simple explanation.

Here’s your hero of the day: it’s The Man Who Convicts War Criminals In The Hague.

Jack Smith was spotted at an outdoor music festival this past weekend, wearing a ‘No Kings’ tee-shirt.

Maybe Donny should invite Iran to nuke Jack Smith. Y’know, kill two birds with one stone.

Hey, let’s do some Daily Claudia.

Here we have a trio of selfies that I pulled off of Ms Spouse’s phone, from July 15, 2023. Ms Spouse sure did love her hats. She had dozens. I think I ended up gifting this one to bff Kathy.

Have a great Tuesday, everyone. Remember, the worst thing about socialism is that it’s socialism.

items.title: What the fuck is this?
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
UPDATE: 11:33 EDT: it has come to my attention that the image of Piss-Drunk Pete at the top of this post was generated by a six-fingered plagiarism robot and is NOT REAL. This is why I should never write a post when I’m sleep-deprived. Sorry, everyone. I will vow to do better. I still stand behind the other 99% of this post. —Jeff T.

I am now back at home, after having spent four awesome days visiting Daughter Katie and Son-in-Law Norrin. It’s always wonderful to hang out with them both, and we all had a great weekend.

This morning, after a long night of air travel, I’m once again rather burned out and in need of a day to recover — so please forgive me for posting a couple of quick hits. I’ll be back tomorrow with the usual full-length screed. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Bribe the Vote™ — Preznit Fuckwit’s patently illegal scheme to line the pockets anyone who’ll vote for Republicans — rolls on. But his latest ruse is a bit different. This time, he’s giving free money to every , no strings attached. Just remember who did you a solid, when it comes time to pull the lever.

“I’m pleased to announce that over— twenty million seniors on Medicare will soon be receiving a— deposit of nearly one hundred dollars directly into— THEIR bank accounts. Through our— war on fraud, we have already reduced your— Medicare premiums by— $132 per year, which is a record. Now, October premiums will be offset— with these additional funds, and seniors will be— able to use that money— for their healthcare needs.”

Okay, let’s leave aside the fact that Dear Demented Leader is so goddamned illiterate that he can barely read off the cue cards his minders put in front of him, resulting in that weird, halting cadence of his. Let’s talk instead about what he’s doing here.

Look, I’m an and on Medicare. Sure, I’ll take the money. Why not? Who wouldn’t like a ? But let’s be clear about two things. First, Donny isn’t funding this gift by rooting out fraud. There is no fraud to root out. He’s doing it through slight of hand, by robbing Peter to pay Paul, as the saying goes — and even Congressional Republicans think that Donny’s financial hocus-pocus

A Republican congressional aide told Dan Diamond of the Washington Post that lawmakers had been planning to use the fund to help fund several health programs this year, and were taken aback by Trump’s announcement.

Second, ‘almost a hundred’ is nice, for sure, but it’s a drop in the bucket in Donny’s inflationary hellscape. Two tanks of gas, and boom, it’s gone. I hope Dear Leader doesn’t imagine that his almost-a-hundred is going to be a life-altering event for anyone.

Donny wants a cookie for doling out a tiny pittance to you, while at the same time grifting billions off his gullible worshipers. Fuck you, Donny — you don’t get a cookie.

Remember — Donny isn’t doing this out of the goodness of his heart. This isn’t the work of a great humanitarian. This is the desperate act of a losing loser who knows he’s going to fucking lose.

Shut the fuck up, Donny. No one’s reading that shit.

Donny should be thanking his lucky stars right now. He’s too dim to realize that Fox News is doing him a favor by not airing any of his batshit speeches.

Donny’s toxic right now. He’s fucking kryptonite. No Republican running for reelection wants voters to be reminded that this is the idiot who clownfucked the country in an unwinnable don’t-you-dare-call-it-a-war on Iran that’s jacked the price of through the roof.

Fox is actually doing what’s right for the GOP, but all Dear Leader can do is bellyache about how he’s not getting the attention he imagines he deserves.

Boo fucking hoo, dipshit. Maybe try not to

Now what. The fuck. Is this?

On the left is our piss-drunk, power-mad, in-love-with-himself Secretary of Death, Pete Kegstand, a couple-three days ago.

On the right is some fucking asshole.

How does this keep happening? Why does it seem as if these fucksnoots are trying to create their own Turd Reich?

Why does the administration’s iconography look as if it were deliberately copied from a 1930 Nuremberg rally?

Why does the Pocket Nazi, Obergruppenführer Greg Bovino, dress as if he were literally a Nazi in your pocket?

Why does Stephen Miller always look like he’s trying to win a Joseph Goebbels look-alike contest?

How is it that the Space Nazi sieg-heils in exactly the same manner — — as that fucking asshole used to?

Spoiler alert: This is not an accident. It’s not some weird coincidence.

These fascist shit-kazoos are not just Nazi wanna-bees. They’re literal Nazis,

They’re the baddies, and they

Lastly, please indulge me for a moment, and allow me to be a proud father.

Twenty years ago, at the age of fifteen, Daughter Katie started a weekly webcomic about video gaming. She called it Awkward Zombie.

She’s still at it. This morning, Katie posted her . I think that’s a pretty fucking cool accomplishment.

And now, it’s Daily Claudia time.

Today, I want to celebrate Ms Spouse’s friendship with her bestie Kathy, because I love revisiting just how much these two genuinely enjoyed each other’s company.

This next one is outside the Ossining restaurant 3 Westerly Bar and Grill, on July 29, 2021. I’m so fond of it that it’s been the desktop image on my laptop since the day I took it.

items.title: Preznit Fuckwit: still a moron, still insane, still a loser. Let us count the ways.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Film legend Barbara Stanwyck once famously quipped that her only professional challenge was “finding a way to play my fortieth fallen female in a different way from my thirty-ninth.”

Those of us who spend our lives reporting on the infantile antics of the pants-shittingest piss-baby ever to crap himself raw in the Oval Bordello have a similar issue. With Dear Leader’s firehose of malignant fuckery spraying directly into our faces, twenty-four-seven, how do we keep that shit fresh? How do we find some new angle on the madness, and not repeat ourselves?

“We’re gonna win big, and we’re gonna shove it up their ass.”

Oh, how charming. That was Donny, at a campaign rally last night in Vandalia, Ohio — and he’s closing the deal by promising that will get . How nice!

Donny’s rancid anus-mouth has always been a ticking time bomb — but at least he kind of used to keep it barely civil, . Not any more. His rapidly-advancing dementia has collapsed his cortex to the point where all the filters have gone . Now, you never know how low Donny might go.

So we’ve got that going for us.

“And we will pass— the DEATH penalty for large scale drug dealers, human traffickers, and anyone— who EVER KILLS a police officer, or law enforcement official.”

Again, that was Donny, last night in Ohio — but it could have been any one of his campaign rallies, at any time during the last decade. Donny’s been making the same worn-out promises, over and over — and has followed though on none of them, despite holding majorities in the House and the Senate. How many times has this fucker promised that his glorious health care plan will be ready in two weeks? Same with infrastructure. How many times? I have no idea, because I can’t count that high.

But look at all the cultists standing behind Dear Leader, jumping for joy and pumping their fists as he makes the exact same promise to KILL EVERYONE that he made in 2016. Does MAGA even remember that they’ve been cheering for the same empty words, over and over? I’m guessing — because massive head trauma doesn’t magically cure itself overnight.

So how do you find some new angle to report on that shit? Unfortunately, until someone comes out with a movie about some homie who can no longer form lasting memories, it’s going to be the dude from Memento, .

Oh, and before any of you smart-asses pipes up with, ‘but Uncle Jeff, what about Fifty First Dates,’ let me just point out that no one remembers that flick even exists.

Don’t you love how Donny makes every campaign appearance about himself? Last night’s speech was ostensibly in support of Vivek Ramaswamy — but if you blinked at the wrong time, you missed the nanosecond where Dear Leader mentioned Vivek, before launching back into some incomprehensible Shakespearean soliloquy about

“and just yesterday, Bayer— I love their aspirin, I take an aspirin a day. I don’t know if it works but psychologically I need it. It thins the hell out of your blood, I guess. I don’t know if it works or not but I’ve been doing it for a long time. And here I am making speeches. Bayer— and I LIKE BAYER aspirin. Little, yellow— and I take the big one. You know they want me to go down to the eighty. I take the three-hundred and— eighty six, I don’t know what the hell it is. It's a monster. They said, ‘SIR YOU DON’T NEED THAT!’ I said, do me a favor, I’ve been doing okay for 35 years. Leave me alone.”

But tell me, after sitting through that meandering dollop of dumbfuckery, do you think MAGA even remembers who they’re supposed to be voting for?

Well, just to be a dick about it, I’m going to drop in a meme from Fifty First Dates, and you’re all going to go,

Yeah, I have no fucking clue what that’s about, either. Like you, I’ve never seen Fifty First Dates. That why we keep falling back on Memento.

I’m sorry, what we were even talking about?

Oh yeah, right — Dear Leader’s batshit campaign speech. Sorry, I keep drifting off.

“We will pass the No Invasion of Our Country ACT— prohibiting any future president from ever opening our borders to illegal immigrants again. What? We will pass a truly great healthcare plan.”

Yeah, None of that shit is going to happen. Donny’s nonsensical promise to magically pass legislation he hasn’t been competent enough to have already passed is no different from Donny sitting down with bankers and investors back in 1984 and promising that his planned Atlantic City casinos were going to make everyone rich.

Tell me, how did that work out for everyone who fell for the slick patter of Donny the flim-flam man?

Donny’s just chock-full of bullshit. Always has been, always will be.

The bottom line is that who gives a shit what memes I use to mock the fuckery. All that matters is that Donny is super toxic right now. He’s massively unpopular — even among the GOP — and every time he shows up at one of these shittacular rallies, he just digs himself and his party deeper.

Shoot that shit straight into my veins.

Get out and vote on November 3rd. It’ll ruin Donny’s day. I promise.

After all that, I think we’ve earned ourselves some Daily Claudia. Wouldn’t you agree?

Here’s a trio of Ms Spouse, enjoying a boating excursion on the Hudson River near Rhinebeck, on July 15, 2017.

Have a great Sunday, everyone.

items.title: This week in stupid: October 3 edition
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
As another stupid week comes to a close here in America, let’s look back at the dumbest fucking shit that happened.

Monday: new Mamdani scandal drops

Folks, it’s a well-known fact that New York City has become an unlivable hell-hole ever since that Islamomarxistfascistcommunoterrorist, Zohran Mamdani, took over as Mayor. But let me tell you — you have no idea just how fucking deep the rot goes.

Greg Gutfeld: ‘It’s something that a lot of people aren’t talking about in terms of quality of life issues, and I don’t know if you have photos of what’s going on in that area, but, uh, how overweight the hookers have become. Have you noticed that?’

I have to confess, I didn’t notice. It’s not really my thing, so I’ll have to defer to the obviously extensive expertise of horndogs like Gutfield and Watters.

Just let me say that I didn’t have ‘let’s fat-shame the sex workers’ on my Wingnut Grievance Bingo card.

Tuesday: history, as interpreted by morons

Folks, did any of you have ‘Richard Nixon was framed’ on your Wingnut Grievance Bingo cards?

Of course you didn’t. Everyone agrees Nixon was lawless as fuck. It was his own party that convinced him to resign. I mean, no one would be revisionist enough to believe otherwise, right?

West Virginia Republican Rep. Riley M. Moore: “Richard Nixon was absolutely couped out of office and was framed. All of this was fake.”

What in the world? ‘Nixon was set up by the Deep State’ is such a weird hill to die on. Even Tricky Dick was all-too-happy to confess to every bit of the fucked-up shit he did. His whole deal was, ‘when the president does it, it’s not illegal,’ remember?

Remember how we all laughed at the patently ridiculous notion of a president being above the law?

Yeah, well, no one’s laughing now — so shut the fuck up about how Republican Rep. Riley M. Moore, and just enjoy the fact that your current guy is a Very Special Boy who gets to crime all he wants.

Bro, quit while you’re ahead.

Wednesday: signed, sealed, delivered

This week, Preznit Fuckwit took it upon himself to rename ‘Artificial Intelligence’ to ‘Super Intelligence.’ You see, Donny is basically Humpty Dumpty now, and words mean whatever he wants them to mean.

Oh my god — they typo’d the living shit out of the proclamation. How you do fuck that up? How do you misspell ‘United’ as ‘Unites’?

I mean, obviously Dear Leader is too fucking stupid to notice. The guy who had to be told that ‘dumb’ has a ‘b’ in can’t be expected to actually read whatever his minders put in front of him to sign. But didn’t anyone one in the White House chain of command notice? I swear, it’s morons all the way down.

THANK YOU FOR YOUR LACK OF ATTENTION TO EVERY MATTER.

Someday, the mutant cockroaches who will inherit the planet from us, after Donny turns it into a radioactive cinder, will teach that document in their schools. It’s going to be Exhibit A for How Humanity Blew It.

Thursday: was that wrong?

folks, Ken Paxton — Texas’s ethically-bankrupt Attorney General — wants you to know that it’s unfair of you to claim he let a child predator walk the streets a free man after serving only one day in prison.

‘The criticism has been that I let a child predator out after one day. Well guess what? They served 60 days.”

Got that, you stupid leftist? Ken didn’t just slap the child predator’s wrist once — he slapped it sixty times. Check and mate, you commie. Now leave Ken alone.

Hey, you’ll never guess what: Kenny Korruptionpants is lying his insipid fucking face off. That’s not even how that shit went down. Community Notes, can you give us a quick fact-check?

Paxton’s office initially recommended 1 day in jail for Adam Hoffman after he pled guilty to two misdemeanors in his child sex abuse case. The judge increased it to 60 days. Hoffman served about 30 days and did not have to register as a sex offender.

Got that? It was who wanted Rapey McKiddlyfiddler to serve only one day — and the dude ended up serving only thirty days, not sixty. Ken can’t understand why people are up in arms about it. Seriously, was that wrong?

I tell ya, Ken Paxton has to plead ignorance on this thing. Because if anyone had said anything at all to him when he first became Attorney General that that sort of thing was frowned upon…

Imagine being such a black hole of morality that you can’t understand what all the fuss is over cutting some predator a sweetheart deal that lets him avoid the of prison time he deserves. Dude is a twenty-four-seven corruption factory — and he wants to be Texas’ senator.

Texas, do the rest of the universe a solid on November 3rd, and vote this asshole back into obscurity, where he belongs.

Friday: the further adventures of Some Fucking Idiot™

Some fucking idiot has a brilliant, can’t-miss plan to turn it all around, and prevent the coming Republican bloodbath at the midterm elections. The fucking idiot is going on the road, doing campaign rallies almost every day between now and November 3.

‘absolutely, you fucking idiot, please do this. The more voters see of you, the more they loathe you. So knock yourself out, homey. Go for it.’

Wait, did I say it was a of Emotional Support Morons? Silly me, I misspoke. The arena was a fucking ghost town. Those are some Republicans down there in Alabama, let me tell you.

The fucking idiot also bragged about how he won the Iraq war in just one day. No, wait, it was two or three weeks. No wait, we’re still there — because we’re apparently staying there. Holy shit, my head hurts just from typing out that last paragraph.

When the speech was over, the fucking idiot high-tailed it out of there without stopping to talk to the press — which means that not one reporter had the opportunity to stand up and ask, ‘what the fuck is wrong with you?’

How fucking idiotic is that?

And now, let’s put a close to This Week in Stupid and have us some Daily Claudia.

Here are two from the living room, on April 29, 2023.

And one from the back yard, by the woodshed, on April 4, 2020.

Have a non-stupid Saturday, everyone.

items.title: Preznit Fuckwit takes war advice from the Space Nazi’s Mecha-Hitler bot. Hilarity doesn’t ensue.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Almost my entire yesterday was a nightmarish hellscape of delayed flights, canceled flights, and, on top of that, delayed-and-then-canceled flights. I didn’t get home until well after 2 am.

Right now I am so frazzled and sleep-deprived that there’s no way I can crank out a full-length post — so please forgive me for taking a rare day off.

I’ll be back tomorrow with This Week in Stupid. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

But before I go, I need to do a couple of very quick hits — New shit has come to light, man.

It seems that when Donny was plotting to steal Venezuela’s oil and kidnap its leader, one of his most-trusted advisors was a janky, six-fingered plagiarism robot — but it wasn’t just plagiarism robot, oh no sirree bob. it was Grok, the Space Nazi’s own personal plagiarism robot.

In December 2025, Elon Musk returned to the Oval Office for a clandestine meeting. Trump spent hours asking Grok, Musk’s AI chatbot, questions about his presidency and legacy, according to an official present.

Donny spent literal hours deep in conversation with this abomination. I’ll bet you anything that he eventually forgot he wasn’t talking to a human.

Naturally, Donny’s ego took over, , and he asked Mecha-Hitler if kidnapping Maduro would make him popular.

At the time, Trump was ordering missile strikes against Venezuelan boats he alleged were smuggling drugs into the U.S. He asked Grok how Venezuelans would react if the U.S. captured Maduro. According to the official present, the chatbot responded that Maduro was a repressive and deeply unpopular dictator and that many Venezuelans would likely celebrate his downfall.

Mecha-Hitler told Donny that invading Venezuela was a totes awesome thing to do. That’s what AIs do, tell the user what they want to hear. There’s even a phrase for it: ‘AI Sycophancy.’ And it’s fucking dangerous, especially—

if and when the user can no longer distinguish between genuine affirmation and performative flattery.

Gee, does that sound like anyone we know? Donny’s entire White House runs on people doing performative flattery to manipulate him into doing what the want.

‘Sycophantic AI’ is a thing that software engineers have had to work hard to program out of their AIs, because that shit was causing people to harm themselves —

Litigation against ChatGPT claims that the chatbot systematically validated and amplified the delusions of Stein-Erik Soelberg, contributing to his committing homicide.

It’s just super fucking insane that a demented imbecile in command of a nuclear arsenal is taking war advice from a six-fingered flattery-bot. Leaving Donny alone with an AI is like leaving him alone with Chucky.

What could possibly go wrong?

OK, here’s the other thing I want to highlight — and then, I promise I’m outta here.

He’s gonna fix it. Believe in him ... all the abortion, it’s evil ... I want to see 2 people — Trump and Jesus ... we do not want Muslims taking over...I have horrible thoughts. I don't think they should be here. This isn’t their country ... they need to pack up ande go back where they came from.”

I don’t even know what to say about this, except that it’s a cult — a cult made up of hateful, ignorant morons.

It’s 31 days until the midterms. We need to out-vote these shitheads, and take away their power.

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through another week in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

here are two from the 1980s, taken by Ms Spouse’s bestie Mandi.

Have a great Friday, everyone. My god, I really suck at taking the day off. Look, this one’s only 867 words. that’s like half a day off, so there’s that.

items.title: Let’s all look on in horror as a racist game show host does a racism
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Here’s one sure way to tell that Preznit Fuckwit and his party are panicking about having lost the support of the Hispanic community, four and a half weeks before the mid-term elections: it’s that our racist-in-chief is suddenly pretending to give a shit about brown people.

“So there’s a tunnel, going to— what I think will be the greatest ballroom ever— built? it’s also a tremendous military complex with a drone port on top. it’s— it’s QUITE THE PLACE. And you [here, Donny make accordion hands] literally will be the first group EVER TO ENTER the premises. So be VERY CAREFUL. DON’T FALL OVER THE EDGE, ’cause it’s A LONG WAY DOWN. And only a Hispanic could survive that fall. So I’m not overly worried.”

That was Donny, in the East Room of the White House yesterday, for a hastily-organized dog-and-pony show ostensibly celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month. You’ll notice they held the event on the last day of the month, like the afterthought it was.

So there’s Blabbermouth McChucklefuck, yammering away about the big strong tunnel with tears in its eyes, leading to a ballroom like few thought possible, when the coked-up squirrel scampering about in his head suddenly — and without warning — veers into a racism. But not just racism — it’s a racism he invented on the spot.

I’ve been around racists and racism all my life, and I’ve never heard about this preternatural ability of Hispanics to survive falls. Have you?

No biological or scientific evidence indicates that people of any specific ethnic or racial background can survive a high fall. [1, 2]

Donny is like and had a baby, and then repeatedly dropped it on its head.

This abject imbecile should not be president. It’s a waste of his singular ability to be incoherent as fuck. He should be the host of a game show called Donny Says Shit.

I’m talking about a show where Donny blurts out whatever dumbfuckery pops into his head, and contestants compete to come up with the most logical explanation — and, in this case, our winner is BlueSly user LadyPup.

Trump whisper interpretation: Hispanics survive the fall cuz they gets lots of practice going over the border wall.

Yup, I think that is the most plausible interpretation.

A new poll from the Pew Research Center shows that President Donald Trump is losing support among Hispanic voters as well as the wider Hispanic community, with 70% disapproving of his performance.

It’s a no-brainer. You can’t have state-sponsored thugs rounding up every brown person they see and disappearing them into slave-labor gulags, and expect those same people to give you a thumbs-up and go,

And not one of these act-first-and-think-never morons saw it coming.

Not even the original Nazis were this clueless. There’s no record of Hitler going, ‘what’s up with the Jews, why don’t they like us any more?’

Trump says that his convention had 107 million views and the NFL game that night had 25 million.

Here are the actual Nielsen-based estimates for TV/streaming viewers across Fox News, Newsmax and NewsNation: 3.3 Million Trump Speech

That idiotic Emotional Support Convention that Donny threw for himself a couple week back has been the gift that keeps on coming — .

Question: “Do you think Trump is a bit of a drag?”

Paxton: “To be honest with you, when we did that midterm convention, it dropped our numbers. Everybody’s numbers dropped. Yeah. Not good.”

Yup, it’s true — every person who watched that two-day waste of time came away from it even convinced that Donny and the Republican Party

That includes that Republican Party, and it’s looking like Korrupt Kenny might finally have to stop stealing for a living and get an actual job.

Boo fucking hoo, my dude.

Some days, it’s as if our entire nation’s armed forces were being run by an emotionally-stunted six-year-old boy who broke into his parent’s liquor cabinet and guzzled an entire bottle of gin.

“It’s worth saying again so the fake news understands it. We are no longer the woke department, or the weak department. Simple translation of that — no fatties, no trannies, no beardos, no weirdos, no wimps, no radicals. Just warriors.”

Oh my god, what an asshole.

You’ll notice that Pete didn’t exclude drunks from being in his Big Boy Military.

What I also wonder about Pete is, ? No normal person is this hung up on whatever he imagines ‘masculinity’ to be.

Clearly, he’s over-compensating for some humiliation buried in his past. What was it? Did he get shoved into one too many lockers? Did he get brutally rejected when he asked someone to the prom? Something happened — and now the rest of us have to bear the brunt of Piss-Drunk Pete’s desperate need to prove to the world that he’s not the dweeb that Mary Lou laughed at back in high school.

“Project Meridian will be co-led by three of our nation's best minds: Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey, and Newt Gingrich.”

I have no idea what Project Meridian is — not do I want to know — but I have a pretty good idea that whatever it is, it’s going to a shittacular disaster, because look at the clucksterfuck of dinguses that Pete’s put in charge of it. Newt Gingrich, Palmer Luckey, and the Space Nazi.

Yeah, now there’s a trio I’d trust — if I were a fucking moron. Or a piss-drunk Secretary of Death — but I repeat myself.

Newtie has no experience in either engineering or warfare,

The Space Nazi is the ketamine-addled visionary behind Forkship One, the spacecraft that will someday ferry all of humanity straight up Uranus.

And Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand is, of course, the buffoonish shit-kadoodle best known for flipping a skateboard up into his own nuts.

That’s right, it’s Daily Claudia Time.
